title: Bob Maguire measures his girlfriend's implant with an RF detector
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bob Maguire measures his girlfriend's implant with an RF detector, about recent at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Cuz I I just interviewed Bob Maguire whose girlfriend uh has an implant and he put like an RF detector over her head and can like measure the frequency coming out.
